description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition, which is responsible for managing and filtering URI definitions within the HTMLPurifier library. It handles registration of various URI filters, setup of member variables based on configuration, and provides filtering mechanisms for URIs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIDefinition
classes.description: A class that manages URI definitions within the HTMLPurifier library, supporting registration and application of various URI filters, and setting up URI-related configuration.

methods.name: registerFilter
methods.description: Registers a new URI filter into the list of registered filters.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to either postFilters or filters based on its 'post' property, after preparing it with the provided configuration.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Initializes the URI definition, setting up member variables and filters based on configuration.

methods.name: setupFilters
methods.description: Sets up the registered filters according to their 'always_load' property and configuration settings.

methods.name: setupMemberVariables
methods.description: Initializes the host, base URI, and default scheme based on configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the default URI scheme from the scheme registry.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies all filters in 'filters' to a given URI.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Applies all filters in 'postFilters' after initial filtering.
